title: parapyrenaria multisepala
intro: Parapyrenaria multisepala, commonly known as the Himalayan maidenhair fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Theaceae. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, such as inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues, due to its impressive array of health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Parapyrenaria multisepala include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which help to alleviate symptoms associated with various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
